detail.longDescription:
Andarium lets you run an Android virtual machine on your iPhone and iPad—no computer setup, extra downloads, or complicated configuration required.

Set up your virtual machine, tap Start, and run the Android apps you need.

BUILT-IN SYSTEM
• Includes an Android 17 system based on LineageOS right inside the app.
• Runs locally on your device with no account sign-in, ads, or tracking.

APPS & FILES
• Install APK files directly from the Files app.
• Browse storage and import or export files and folders with the built-in File Browser.

GRAPHICS, DISPLAY & INPUT
• 3D graphics and video playback with adjustable display resolution.
• Automatic screen rotation plus motion and compass support.
• Multitouch support and a movable on-screen Side Keys menu for Power, Volume, Back, Home, and Settings.
• Works with hardware keyboards, mice, and trackpads on iPad, plus Bluetooth and MFi controllers.

CUSTOMIZE, PERMISSIONS & BACKUPS
• Optional switches for Camera, Location, Microphone, and haptic feedback.
• Adjust CPU, memory, display resolution, and storage size, and optionally include your data in iCloud or device backups.
• Save Snapshots to back up your virtual machine state and restore it later.

DEVELOPER FEATURES
• Wireless ADB forwarding lets you connect adb from a computer on your local network.
• Live on-screen stats, diagnostic bug report export, and built-in email feedback.

COMPATIBILITY & NOTES
• Requires an Apple A14 chip or newer (iPhone 12 or later, or an iPad with an A14 or M-series chip).
• At least 10 GB of free storage is recommended for initial setup.
• The virtual machine runs while Andarium is open on screen and pauses when you switch apps.

PRIVATE & OPEN SOURCE
Andarium collects no personal data, analytics, or telemetry. Source code is available at https://github.com/imxieyi/Kernarium.
